content.text: Only the second Indian to travel to space, Group Captain Shukla's journey occurred 41 years after cosmonaut Rakesh Sharma's flight on a Russian Soyuz in 1984.

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has revealed its intention to send Gaganyaan, the nation’s inaugural manned space mission, into orbit in 2027. Furthermore, it has set ambitious goals to establish a space station by 2035 and to dispatch an astronaut to the Moon by 2040.
